name: Greenville
tagline: Revitalized Southern Charm at the Foot of the Blue Ridge
description: Greenville has transformed from a quiet textile town into one of the South's most vibrant small cities. Falls Park on the Reedy anchors a walkable downtown filled with excellent restaurants, galleries, and boutiques. The Blue Ridge foothills are minutes away, housing costs remain well below the national average, and South Carolina's low taxes make every FIRE dollar go further. For retirees seeking culture, nature, and affordability in one polished package, Greenville delivers.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – safe downtown core; standard precautions in outlying areas
quickFacts.climate: Humid subtropical with mild winters, warm summers, and moderate rainfall year-round

housing.description: Cheapest-acceptable older 1BR or value studio in the Village of West Greenville, Nicholtown, Overbrook, or Gower

dining.description: Casual meals out a few times a week; Southern diners and taco trucks; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: ACA marketplace Silver plan on the SC exchange, subsidized if MAGI is kept under the 2026 400%-FPL cliff (~$62,600 single); assumes an early retiree (45–55) — older retirees budget more

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with insurance; a car is essential in the Upstate, and SC auto premiums run high

entertainment.description: Walking the Swamp Rabbit Trail, free Falls Park visits, library events; an occasional movie

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable older one-bedroom or value studio in the Village of West Greenville, cooking at home most nights with a casual meal out a few times a week. Healthcare and the near-essential car form a hard cost floor, and the ACA Silver premium stays low only if MAGI is managed under the 2026 ~$62,600 cliff. Daily life centers on the Swamp Rabbit Trail, Falls Park, and the free pleasures of a walkable downtown. Tight, but the low cost base and SC's light tax load make it workable.

housing.description: A decent 1BR downtown-adjacent or a small place in the Augusta Road neighborhood

dining.description: Dining on Main Street several times a week across Greenville's acclaimed restaurant scene

healthcare.description: A Silver plan; net cost stays low only if MAGI is managed under the ~$62,600 cliff

transportation.description: A reliable car for Blue Ridge day trips, full coverage insurance

entertainment.description: Peace Center shows, Greenville Drive baseball, a yoga studio, mountain hiking trips

2M.lifestyle: A decent one-bedroom downtown or a small place on Augusta Road, dining out several times a week on Main Street and catching shows at the Peace Center. Weekends run to hiking the Blue Ridge foothills or a Greenville Drive game. Good coverage and a reliable car for mountain day trips are covered, with room left over each month.

housing.description: A high-quality 1BR or small home in the North Main or Earle Street area, some with mountain views

dining.description: Regular dining at Jianna, Nose Dive, and Soby's; wine dinners and tasting events

healthcare.description: A Gold-tier plan (Prisma Health network); padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff where premium tax credits phase out

transportation.description: A late-model SUV for mountain excursions, premium insurance

entertainment.description: Peace Center season tickets, a golf club membership, art classes, Clemson football trips

3M.lifestyle: A high-quality small home in the North Main or Earle Street area, some with mountain views, with regular dinners at Jianna and Soby's, Peace Center season tickets, and a golf membership. A late-model SUV handles mountain excursions, healthcare is a Gold plan padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff, and there is plenty of margin for travel. At Greenville's price level, this covers a genuinely affluent life that would cost considerably more in larger Southern cities.

housing.description: A luxury condo or custom home in the Chanticleer or Paris Mountain area, or prime downtown

dining.description: Fine dining several nights a week, a private chef for dinners, exclusive wine-club memberships

healthcare.description: An unsubsidized Gold/Platinum plan plus concierge medicine and integrative wellness

transportation.description: A luxury SUV plus a second vehicle; occasional flights from GSP

entertainment.description: A country club membership, private fly-fishing guides, arts patronage, Clemson suite tickets

domesticHelp.description: Weekly deep cleaning, lawn and garden service, property maintenance

luxuryExtras.description: Mountain-cabin getaways, quarterly travel, art collecting, community philanthropy

5M.lifestyle: A luxury condo or custom home near Chanticleer or Paris Mountain, weekly housekeeping, and concierge healthcare. Regular fine dining, a country club membership, and fly-fishing trips on Upstate streams fill the calendar, with business-class flights and weekend getaways to a mountain cabin well within budget. Greenville's low costs make this feel very well-resourced.

housing.description: A trophy estate on Paris Mountain or a sprawling property in the Cliffs communities

dining.description: A private chef, exclusive catered events, private wine dinners, farm partnerships

healthcare.description: A top-tier unsubsidized concierge practice plus executive wellness — fully out of subsidy range

transportation.description: Multiple luxury vehicles, private car service, chartered flights from GSP

entertainment.description: Major arts patronage, private concert bookings, international travel, exclusive club events

domesticHelp.description: Full-time estate manager, housekeeper, and groundskeeper

luxuryExtras.description: A second home on the coast, first-class travel, art gallery sponsorships, foundation giving

10M.lifestyle: A trophy estate on Paris Mountain or a property in the Cliffs communities, full-time domestic staff, and a private chef several days a week sourcing from Upstate farms. First-class travel, a second home on the coast, and top-tier concierge healthcare are all comfortable. Greenville's small-city costs mean roughly $203k a year covers premium living with very large margins.
